THE ASK
Tournament art landed, but every tournament still feels like the same tournament.

SHIPPED — A + C on cards, D on the detail hero.
A (land reveal) is the one that answers the complaint: each row arrives as its own title card. C (press response) is the floor — free, and it makes the art feel attached to the row. D gives the detail screen depth, and a back button that survives scrolling.

Live in src/lib/motion.ts, TournamentArt, TournamentCard, FeaturedTournament, TournamentHero and tournament/[id].tsx.

B (Ken Burns) not built — detail hero only, if ever, never in the list.
E (shimmer) not built — motion covering for missing data. Spend that effort on organiser banner upload instead.

FIVE OPTIONS, ONE AXIS EACH
One-shot · ambient · input-driven · scroll-driven · fallback-only.
Every card below is real geometry from TournamentCard.tsx and TournamentHero.tsx. Banner photos are CSS placeholders — the repo has no tournament photography yet.
